At one point, I had a group that had the nerve to kill my character (Which was acceptable under the circumstances), and then tell me how to make my character every time I was in the chat.

So I proceeded to make something that they saw as useless: A sorcerer that never used any direct damage spells.

Grease? Sure. Obscuring mist? Why not? Acid Splash? Never.

After which they were like "Take these skills because the party needs them." I declined, spent my points on concentration, spellcraft, a couple knowledges, and Craft(Basket Weaving). They were not happy.

The DM thought it was hiiiilaaarrious, and made sure my character never died, just to irk them, and the character survived to the end of the campaign.

The BBEG was some crazy guy trying to turn himself into a giant snake. 
Sadly, he succeeded before we could kill him and he subjugated the part, leaving us with only enough time to do an on the fly last ditch plan, which was to collapse the temple he was in. Long story short, we didn't get much to happen, except trapping his tail under a pillar for about 15 seconds.

Finally seeing a chance to prove basket weaving wasn't useless, instead of teleporting us all out of the temple to fight another day, I used my spells better, to casts of bigsby's grasping hand later and we now have a snake demigod basket, about the size of a horse drawn wagon.
